findings.issue: Carried over from attempt 1, still present. Possible duplicated code: descriptionOf repeats the spreadsheet/sheet/field walk from Mappings.Field only to get Description, which FieldRef leaves out.
findings.fix: Add Description to FieldRef, fill it in Mappings.Field, and remove descriptionOf.

findings.issue: Carried over from attempt 1, still present. Duplicated code: the year-on-year change calculation appears twice in TestDataConsistency (the findings loop and the 'non-planted change below 10' loop), so the two checks can drift apart.
findings.fix: Extract a helper such as changeOf(cur, prior *big.Rat, unit string) *big.Rat and call it from both loops.

findings.issue: Carried over from attempt 1. strings.TrimPrefix(rc, "esg-")[:3] derives the section short name by slicing a string, while TestRecipesMatchSchemaAndMappings keeps an explicit {id, short} table.
findings.fix: Share one sections table between both tests.

findings.issue: Carried over from attempt 1. LoadRecipes checks required keys by ranging over a map, so which missing key the error names is not deterministic.
findings.fix: Range over an ordered slice of name/value pairs.
